description: Source code implementing MKLDNN-based convolution operations in PyTorch's ATen native library. The file includes functions for forward, backward, and transpose convolutions with MKLDNN optimizations, integrations for fusion and memory format handling, and registration of corresponding dispatch functions.
external_files: <ideep> related headers and any underlying MKLDNN (oneDNN) library headers.
